scheme_name: Spices Development Ginger, Turmeric, Black Pepper, Cardamom, Coriander, Cinnamon and Chillies
other_conditions: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Meghalaya.
Applicant must be a bonafide farmer engaged in agriculture.
Applicant must own or lease land of at least 0.2 hectares.
Beneficiary selection is on a first‑come‑first‑serve basis.
benefits_summary: Produce from the Government Farm at Umsning is sold directly to growers at full rate through District Horticulture Officers.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attest, if required)
